evidence.sqlite_chunks: chunks table stores id, document_id, chunk_index, chunk_text, chunk_metadata JSON.
evidence.qdrant_runtime: retrieve_context returns raw_docs with metadata; vector hits often include chunk_id/document_id, while BM25 hits may include doc_id plus hierarchy/context_header instead.
evidence.source_builder: langchain_engine._build_sources_list currently emits doc_id/document/section/snippet but not context_id; evaluate_rag.py was updated to persist retrieved_context_ids/retrieved_sources for future collect runs.
evidence.ground_truth_mapping: build_ground_truth_canonical.py mapped 30/40 ground-truth rows to actual DB chunks; remaining rows use citation fallback IDs.

decision.recommended_matching_strategy: alias-group matching using dbchunk:<chunk_id>, doc<document_id>:idx<chunk_index>, doc<doc_id>:idx<chunk_index>, and document-slug:section aliases.
decision.recommended_future_ingestion_change: Add canonical_context_id/citation_id at ingestion time and persist it in SQLite, Qdrant payload, BM25 cache, API sources, and eval results.
